richiami.difetto: It has come to our attention that your vehicle is part of a very small number of smart #5 vehicles of which under very specific circumstances the braking software may underperform and lead to unexpected skidding on specific surfaces in icy or wet weather conditions.  Test results have shown that this scenario can occur on low friction surfaces (e.g. epoxy or tilted floors). The issue could not be reproduced on normal road surfaces. Should these specific circumstances occur it cannot be ruled out that the braking leads to skidding and loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: The corrective measure consisting of the release of a new braking software that will correct the deviated behaviour.

richiami.difetto: The wheel bolts were not tightened in accordance with the torque specifications. The bolts and the wheel assembly could detach while the vehicle is in motion, increasing the risk of accidents. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.modello: EQ fortwo cabrio, EQ fortwo coupe
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 18/05/2026
richiami.titolo: The wheel bolts were not tightened in accordance with the torque specifications.

I bulloni e l'insieme della ruota potrebbero staccarsi mentre il veicolo è in movimento, aumentando il rischio di incidenti. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: The windscreen may be incorrectly bonded and could become detached from the body of the car in the event of a crash. The passenger airbag being deployed in this case, could not be supported by the windscreen as intended. As a result, the restraining effect of the passenger airbag could be impaired, increasing the risk of injury. The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown

traduzione.difetto: Il parabrezza potrebbe essere erroneamente incollato e potrebbe staccarsi dal corpo dell'auto in caso di impatto. Nel caso in cui l'airbag passeggero venga attivato, non potrebbe essere supportato dal parabrezza come previsto. Di conseguenza, l'effetto di contenimento dell'airbag passeggero potrebbe essere compromesso, aumentando il rischio di lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde ai requisiti stabiliti dal Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
